subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: After upstream SHA provenance and complete exact-head checks are verified, should this grouped update be accepted across token-, secret-, release-, and agent-bearing workflows?
rationale: The PR intentionally replaces third-party code executed inside privileged workflows, and the protected security signal requires a human to own that supply-chain decision.

options.title: Verify and merge together
options.body: Confirm all 14 upstream SHAs and release mappings, complete exact-head checks, and accept the grouped action update as one reviewed supply-chain change.

options.title: Split privileged actions
options.body: Land low-privilege setup-action bumps separately and isolate token, CodeQL, Docker publishing, and Codex action updates for narrower review.

options.title: Pause the update
options.body: Keep the existing pins until upstream provenance or exact-head workflow behavior can be verified confidently.

recommendation.title: Verify and merge together
recommendation.body: Confirm all 14 upstream SHAs and release mappings, complete exact-head checks, and accept the grouped action update as one reviewed supply-chain change.

likelyOwner.reason: The timeline provides the strongest available human routing signal for the protected workflow and security-boundary decision.
